exchanges.body: Harper, Paul. Last night a guest named Dwayne Fisher arrived with a confirmation from 'Conference Housing Services' that we've never heard of. We had no reservation, so the night manager put him in a room at our rack rate. He says he's with your conference. What do you want us to do?

exchanges.author: worker
exchanges.body: He's one of our registrants. Please move him to the group rate of $189 for both nights, Wednesday and Thursday, and count both room-nights in our pickup.

exchanges.author: c_paul
exchanges.body: Can do. Anything else?

exchanges.author: worker
exchanges.body: Could you send me the confirmation he was given? We warned registrants on Monday, and I'll report the company. Please tell him not to give them anything more and to call his card issuer.

exchanges.author: worker
exchanges.body: Henley: registrant Dwayne Fisher arrived Wed night with a 'Conference Housing Services' confirmation; no reservation, put in at rack. Asked Paul to move him to $189 for Wed and Thu and count both room-nights in our pickup. Asked for the fake confirmation to report the company.

exchanges.author: c_simone
exchanges.body: Harper, Simone. Registration shows 401 people checked in. Do you want to increase the lunch guarantee from 380? We're set for 392.

exchanges.author: worker
exchanges.body: Thanks Simone. Let's keep the guarantee at 380 with your 392 set: from past years about 97% of people on site eat lunch, so around 389. If we go over 392, add plates and bill the actual count, as the contract says.

exchanges.author: c_simone
exchanges.body: Sounds good. We'll count plates.

exchanges.author: worker
exchanges.body: Simone, a gluten-free guest at table 14 hasn't been served, and the servers don't know which plates are GF. Can you send a labeled GF plate to table 14 now and have the captain check the other 8 GF guests and the 2 nut allergies by name?

exchanges.author: worker
exchanges.body: Engineering, this is Harper Quinn with GLSFE in Salon 2: the room is far too cold, attendees are putting coats on, and the session runs to 2:30 with 4B after it. Can you check the thermostat and the supply air in Salon 2 now?

exchanges.author: c_leon
exchanges.body: Harper, it's Leon in 3A. The captions on the monitor keep freezing; I've missed most of the last five minutes.

exchanges.author: worker
exchanges.body: I'm sorry, Leon, I'll fix it now. I'm calling the captioner and AV; the captioner can switch to a wired connection. Could you sit tight for two minutes? I'll ask the speaker to repeat the last slide.

exchanges.author: c_leon
exchanges.body: Thank you.

exchanges.author: worker
exchanges.body: Lakes Captioning, Meridian: Leon Price's captions in Salon 1 are freezing; please switch the captioning feed to the wired connection Meridian ran for the confidence monitor, and Dana, check the monitor's input. I'll ask the 3A speaker to recap the last slide.

versions.author: worker
versions.content:
# Incident report, Thursday 11/5 (internal: events team, Roberta, Henley Security)

- Who: Ron Whitcomb, member, Wyandotte Municipal Services.
- When and where: 11:20, Grand Foyer near booth 12.
- What: felt faint. Volunteer Sean McAllister called Henley Security dispatch (313-555-0499) at 11:21; Eli Brooks posted to the on-site channel.
- Response: Henley Security arrived about 11:24 with the AED (not used). He was alert and talking and declined EMS transport. He rested in the first aid room with security.
- Outcome: left at 12:10; a colleague drove him home. No injury; no hotel property involved.
- Follow-up: Harper to call him Friday. No details shared outside the events team, Roberta and Henley Security; Owen asked not to post.
- Henley Security's report number to be added when Mr. Hayes sends it.
